propositions: The tickets-store branch reaches 1.04 GiB, with 92% attributed to the reconciler's .bridge_state cache containing unused bookkeeping fields (baseline_advanced_at written but never read; last_get_pass rotation metadata).

Scattered edits to the 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression, causing 12.79 KB marginal pack cost per version; removing baseline_advanced_at reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement) and moving rotation bookkeeping halves version churn (12.8x total).

The .bridge_state cache must remain committed to git because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners, requiring durable state durability; earlier designs re-derived 2050+ inbound creates per pass when prev was empty.

A multi-phase approach deletes baseline_advanced_at, moves last_get_pass to a sidecar file with mixed-version read compatibility, narrows prev_snapshot.json to key-sets, and normalizes baseline descriptions while preserving assignee as raw data.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import on real branch reduces stored history from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all commits, merges, and restoring current files to byte-identical HEAD tree.

Rollout gates require operator attestation of descendant workflow execution, explicit host runtime refresh, epoch mismatch refusal proofs, off-repo backup bundle verification, and quiesced publication window with zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers.
